paragraphs: Lily and Mia make a picture. It is a big paper bird. Mia draws the eyes. Pip sits and looks at them. Lily paints the body blue. "Our bird is nice!" says Mia. They put the paper bird on the table. Then they go to the kitchen. They want some juice.

Now the paper bird is not on the table. "Where is our bird?" asks Lily. They look under the table. They look behind the sofa. They look between the books on the bookcase. "I can not find it," says Mia. Mia is sad. Lily is sad too.

Pip sits on the floor next to the sofa. He sits and sits. "Pip, come here," says Lily. Pip comes to Lily. The paper bird is under Pip! Now it is very small and flat. "Oh, Pip!" says Mia. She smiles. "We can make a new bird," says Lily. Pip says, "Woof!"
text.summary: Lily and Mia make a paper bird, but they cannot find it. They look under, behind, and between things, and Pip is sitting on it.
